correctness.rationale: Exact 30-edge graph and facet predicate reconstruct 324 faces from all 4096 subsets. A fully enumerated 152-pair augmented matching leaves 20 three-dimensional critical faces and passes a complete 984-incidence acyclicity topological sort; after removing the empty face, ordinary Morse cells are one zero-cell and twenty three-cells. Forman discrete Morse theory proves an integral wedge of twenty 3-spheres with no assumptions of mod-two lifting. A separate independent mod-two boundary reduction gives ranks 11, 55, 85. All 120 graph automorphisms and their orientation classes are explicitly enumerated, and their signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz characters verify full rational A5×C2 module decomposition. The supplied standalone program has been executed successfully.

value.rationale: A nonarbitrary exact invariant of the canonical 12-vertex highly symmetric icosahedral graph at the first higher-independence threshold. The classification of a pure 3-complex with 105 tetrahedral facets into a 20-sphere wedge is mathematically informative; its 15/5 antipodal-eigenspace distinction and full rational icosahedral automorphism character are not determined by face count, Euler characteristic, or ordinary homology alone and can support subsequent equivariant comparisons. The claimed finite exact classification is substantive without pretending to imply general all-graphs theorems.
